description: social.md §7 scores: self(i), score, agreement (null under karmaOnly), unweighted ('n votes not yet counted'), earlier and weighted ('N of M votes were cast on an earlier version'). input: {fold: FoldInput}. expected: scores (every non-Excluded item) and karma maps. Generated by testdata/vectors/social-ref/gen_social.py from the reference model (testdata/vectors/social-ref/lessdugin_ref); do not edit by hand.

vectors.name: self-score-and-vote-power
vectors.note: gus is a granted seed with KP 10 (mona upvoted 10 of his posts). self(i) = strong(KP) = 2 for his posts and small(KP) = 1 for his comment. His votes have power(KP[gus] = 10, x): up 1, strongUp 2, down −1, strongDown −2; strongAgree 2, disagree −1. alice is not in E (gus's net sign sum on her is 0), so her self is 0

vectors.name: agreement-under-karmaOnly
vectors.note: policy.voting = karmaOnly: the karma axis always counts (mona +1, mike −1: score 0); the agreement axis (mona agree +1, mike strongAgree +1) is ignored, so agreement is null

vectors.name: agreement-under-twoAxis
vectors.note: policy.voting = twoAxis: the karma axis always counts (mona +1, mike −1: score 0); the agreement axis (mona agree +1, mike strongAgree +1) is summed: 2

vectors.name: agreement-under-reacts
vectors.note: policy.voting = reacts: the karma axis always counts (mona +1, mike −1: score 0); the agreement axis (mona agree +1, mike strongAgree +1) is summed: 2

vectors.name: unweighted-counts
vectors.note: on alice's post: mona (E) up is weighted; nina (a member outside E) up is 'not yet counted' (unweighted 1); noah (outside E) has only an agreement value, which is neither weighted nor unweighted; bea is banned (O4: not counted at all); gil (granted, restricted from vote) has no karma or agreement axis left

vectors.name: earlier-version-votes
vectors.note: alice edited her post after mona, mike and nina voted (their subject.cid is the earlier CID); adam voted on the current version. N of M = earlier 2 of weighted 3; nina (outside E) is unweighted and not part of N or M; the owner's agreement-only opinion on the old version counts for agreement but not for N or M. The CID never affects counting

vectors.name: wiki-and-sequence-scores
vectors.note: wes (a granted seed, KP 0) gets self = small(0) = 1 on his wikiRevision (not a post), plus mona's strongUp (1): score 2. sid is outside E (self 0): +1 −1 = 0. No karma is earned

vectors.name: hidden-spam-and-excluded-items
vectors.note: a hidden post keeps its score (votes count: K1 2, seedUp 2, so alice is established with KP 2 and self 1; score 1 + 2 = 3); votes on a spam post are void (O5) and leave self only; an invalid post (PO3: no title) is Excluded and has no score entry

vectors.name: consistency-K-equals-scores-minus-self
vectors.note: §7 consistency: with no pair cap binding and no deleted subjects, K[a] = Σ over a's posts and comments of (score − self): noah (3 − 1) + (0 − 1) = 1, alice (1 − 0) + (0 − 0) = 1

vectors.name: scores-have-no-pair-cap
vectors.note: pairCap 2: mona upvotes three of pat's posts. Each post's score counts mona's vote (no pair cap in scores) while K[pat] is clamped to 2, so here K ≠ Σ (score − self) = 3

vectors.name: earlier-ignores-cid-spelling
vectors.note: alice edited her post. The owner's up cites the current version with its CID in base32 upper case (multibase B), mona's cites the first version, also in upper case. CIDs written in records compare by canonical form (§0.4, §20.1 item 45): only mona's vote was cast on an earlier version (1 of 2). The two seed votes also establish alice, so her self(i) is 1 and the score 3
